SELECT CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS d_utc, CAST(order_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE) AS d_hki, status, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS n_distinct
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29 00:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03 00:00:00'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH o AS (
  SELECT w.*, CAST(order_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE) AS d_hki
  FROM fact_web_order w
  WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 20:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 23:00:00'
), l AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, count(*) AS nl, min(sale_date) AS sd, min(channel_code) AS cc, max(channel_code) cc2, sum(gross_amount) g
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT o.d_hki, o.status, o.login_state, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) nd,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.nl <> o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS line_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.sd <> o.d_hki THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saledate_ne_hki,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.sd <> CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saledate_ne_utc
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-29' AND DATE '2025-12-03' AND (channel_code <> 'ST' OR channel_code IS NULL OR channel_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH o AS (
  SELECT w.*, CAST(order_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE) AS d_hki
  FROM fact_web_order w
  WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 20:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 23:00:00'
), l AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, count(*) AS nl, min(sale_date) AS sd, count(DISTINCT channel_id) nch, min(channel_id) ch, sum(gross_amount) g
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-29' AND DATE '2025-12-03' AND channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT o.d_hki, o.status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) nd,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.nl <> o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS line_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.sd <> o.d_hki THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saledate_ne_hki,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.g - o.order_total_gross) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mismatch
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
